answer: In PoA, reputation decays exponentially with a defined temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, honestly corroborated service to retain weight. EigenTrust normalization propagates trust through reciprocal, transitive endorsements; a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted inbound paths. Whether hidden behind a cipher, on a terrace, or scattered like a gale, its isolated votes cannot reach consensus.
